If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: AWS Architect-AI and Data Solutions Engineer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Artificial Intelligence & Engineering**
AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transforming mission-critical operations.
  
  
Join our AI & Engineering team to help in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping help make a significant impact on our clients' success achievements. You’ll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are could be critical to businesses.
  
  
**Level:**
**AI and Data Solutions Engineer**
As an AI and Data Solutions Engineer at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
Lead discussions with business and functional analysts to understand requirements and assess integration impacts on business architecture. Prepare technical architecture and design, clarify requirements, and resolve ambiguities. Develop solutions in line with established technical designs, integration standards, and quality processes. Create and enforce technical design and development guides, templates, and standards. Facilitate daily scrum meetings, manage deliverables, and prepare weekly status reports for leadership review. Conduct detailed deliverable reviews and provide technical guidance to team members. Collaborate with onsite clients, coordinators, analysts, and cross-functional teams. Design templates or scripts to automate routine development or operational tasks.
  
  
**The team:**
AI & Data offers a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offering helps clients innovate, and enhance their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.
  
  
AI & Data professionals will work with our clients to:
  
  

* Design and modernize large-scale data and analytics platforms including data management, governance and the integration of structured and unstructured data to generate insights leveraging cloud, edge and AI/ML technologies, platforms and methodologies for storage, processing
* Leverage automation, cognitive and AI based solutions to manage data, predict scenarios and prescribe actions
* Drive operational efficiency by managing and upgrading their data ecosystems and application platforms, utilizing analytics expertise and providing As-a-Service models to ensure continuous insights and enhancements.

Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* 6-9 years of relevant consulting, industry or technology experience
* Experience in provisioning and spinning up AWS EC2 instances - on-Demand, Spot, dedicated instances, and cost calculation.
* Experience with server less architecture (Lambda), API gateway and RESTful services/JSON etc.
* Experience with one or more relational databases on AWS RDS – Oracle/ SQL Server/ MySQL and/or cloud data warehouse databases such as AWS Redshift
* Exposure to Data migration facilities such as DMS, S3 COPY, streaming, Kinesis, Batch
* Experience in developing applications on AWS Cloud infrastructure.
* Exposure to DevOps tools, deployment and orchestration technologies such as AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, AWS CodePipeline etc.
* Experience with monitoring resources and applications using CloudWatch metrics, alarms and logs and tracking user activity, API usage using CloudTrail
* Experience with cloud assessment and migration on-premise workloads onto AWS.
* Expertise in AWS Architecture, Automation Tools and understanding of the agile development process.
* Experience in Migration from on-prem to Cloud using AWS migration tools
* Experience with VPN connectivity between regions and subnets
* Experience with Business Continuity and Disaster Recover design, planning and implementation for cloud infrastructures
* Exposure to one or more - Python, Perl, Ruby or UNIX shell scripting.
* Experience working with AWS Command line utility (CLI) and SDKs.
* Exposure to EMR, Elasticsearch, Kinesis, DynamoDB, Athena, WAF, CloudHMS, Direct Connect, Glue, Load balancer
* Expertise in SPARK programming using Scala or Pyspark or Java
* Experience with cloud security architectures – Encryption (Rest & Motion)

**Preferred:**

* Experience in Cloud Computing (Public/Private/Hybrid) specifically on Cloud first application development
* Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
* Experience maintaining internet facing production-grade applications in virtualized environments in Cloud Platform.
* AWS Certified Associate or Professional

**Education:**

* BE/B.Tech/M.C.A./M.Sc degree or equivalent from accredited university

title: Infra Ops Program Manager, AWS Infra Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Infra Ops Program Manager
  
  
Transform Operational Excellence and Drive Strategic Efficiency Across Multiple Functions
  
  
Are you a detail-oriented program management professional who thrives on optimizing complex operational landscapes? Join our dynamic team and become the strategic linchpin that ensures seamless financial planning, process management, and organizational performance.
  
  
A Day in the Life
  
  
As our Infra Ops Program Manager, you'll be the central hub of operational coordination, bridging multiple teams and driving strategic initiatives. Your day will involve crafting comprehensive financial strategies, managing critical operational metrics, and ensuring our infrastructure programs run with precision and efficiency.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are a collaborative and innovative group dedicated to maintaining operational excellence. Our team focuses on creating streamlined processes, reducing costs, and ensuring our infrastructure programs are executed flawlessly. We value professionals who can navigate complex organizational landscapes with agility and strategic insight.
  
  
Key Job Responsibilities
  
  
Financial Management :Create cost-saving initiatives, track financial efficiency mechanisms, and lead comprehensive financial planning across multiple operational domains
  
  
Process Optimization :Develop and maintain comprehensive dashboards and tracking mechanisms for infrastructure site status and operational performance
  
  
Metrics and Compliance: Coordinate and present key performance indicators, compile executive-level reports, and maintain rigorous documentation standards
  
  
Audit and Site Readiness :Serve as the primary point of contact for external audits and coordinate seamless infrastructure site deployments
  
  
Create detailed documentation and presentations that translate complex data into clear, actionable insights
  
  
Support strategic decision-making by providing robust analytical recommendations
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree

title: Technical Director - OTT Delivery
description:
*For this role you must be able to work on a hybrid basis with at least 2 days per week working in the Mumbai office in Andheri.*

This role sits within Deltatre's Engineering & Technology function, at the interface between clients — both external (broadcasters, rights holders, OTT operators) and internal (product, delivery, commercial) — and the multi-disciplinary teams building the platforms that power OTT streaming, VOD, digital media, and connected consumer experiences for major international sports and entertainment brands. Technical Directors are the point of technical accountability across the full lifecycle of a project, from architecture and estimation through delivery and post-launch iteration.

As Technical Director, you hold full technical ownership across projects spanning multiple platforms and technologies — web front-end (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React), .NET and C# backend services, and native mobile (Android, iOS). You lead architectural decisions, drive requirements gathering and estimation, and combine hands-on technical practice with the leadership and mentoring that scale a team's engineering standards over time. The role rewards technical breadth, credibility with clients under pressure, and the discipline to keep documentation, code quality, and delivery predictability at the level Deltatre platforms require.

**Requirements**

You have led the technical delivery of large-scale, multi-platform projects before — over months, not sprints — and you can hold both the architecture conversation and the client escalation conversation with the same steadiness. You are credible with engineers because you still do the work, and credible with clients because you can explain what is happening technically without hiding behind jargon.

**Required**

* Demonstrated experience delivering large-scale projects or products over multi-month cycles in a technical leadership role — ideally in OTT streaming, digital agency, or a product-based organisation
* Broad technical fluency across the full delivery stack: web front-end (React, JavaScript, HTML, CSS), .NET / C#, native Android, native iOS
* Deep expertise in at least one core mobile stack — Android (Java / Kotlin, RxJava, Dagger, Gradle) or iOS (Swift, Alamofire, Kingfisher, In-App Purchase)
* Solution architecture experience for digital media platforms, with a working understanding of the trade-offs across the delivery stack
* Requirements gathering, refinement, and estimation for complex multi-stream projects
* Stakeholder management experience — external (clients, partners) and internal (product, delivery, commercial)
* Demonstrated track record of upskilling teams through code review, mentoring, and technical guidance by example
* Hands-on experience setting up and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
* Working experience of Agile delivery in practice — not only in principle
* Documentation discipline — solution architecture records, technical specifications, decision logs
* Fluent written and spoken English

**Valued**

* Experience leading projects across multiple regions and time zones
* Familiarity with performance optimisation techniques and tooling for high-scale consumer platforms
* Comfort with rapid prototyping as a means of validating architectural or interaction decisions
* Exposure to multiple software delivery process styles and project management methodologies
* Background in OTT, VOD, live broadcast, or media technology

**Process and what to expect**

* Introductory conversation: a step for us to get to know each other better, and for us to answer all questions you might have around Deltatre.
* 1-hour Technical round of Interview: we will deep dive on your experience and explore the technical and architectural decisions you have made in your past work.
* 1-hour Competency Based Interview: we will ask you situational questions around how you deal with real-life scenarios at work. Easier doing it, more than explaining it.

*If any of these formats would be difficult for you, tell us - we adjust regularly and can usually accommodate.*

*Accessibility and accommodation questions are welcome at any stage. Tell us what would work for you.*

Role Summary
  
  
The Application & Cloud Security Lead will serve as a key security leader within the S&P Global Energy Division BISO team, responsible for coordinating security initiatives across application, cloud, and AI-enabled environments. The successful candidate will partner with technology, product, engineering, cloud, risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into architecture, delivery, operations, and innovation. The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.
  
  
This position requires a hands-on security leader who can translate cybersecurity requirements into practical controls, influence engineering teams, guide secure design decisions, and drive measurable improvements in cyber resilience across the Energy Division.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and coordinate application, cloud, and AI security initiatives across the S&P Global Energy Division in alignment with S&P Global's cyber risk management objectives.

title: Vice President - Cloud Business Office
description:
**Nomura Overview:**

Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com.

Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations.

At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies & programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.

Corporate & Department Overview

Nomura aspires to create a better world by harnessing the power of financial markets. We are a financial services group with an integrated global network, servicing our clients for over 100 years across over 30 countries. By connecting markets East & West, we service the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through our four business divisions:

* Wealth Management
* Investment Management
* Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking) and
* Banking

Nomura puts clients at the centre of everything we do and focuses on integrated global access. We have a long history in Asia and we drive disciplined entrepreneurship.

Nomura pursues a strategy of delivering comprehensive services through a hybrid approach that combines people and digital capabilities. To provide truly optimal services for each individual client, we are proactively building a transformational IT capability. By leveraging technology and the latest trends, we deliver personal and appropriate end-to-end customer experiences.

Nomura is building its Architecture capability to help the business set direction and strategy by providing an enterprise horizontal view of technology; and reducing risk through Group unification of standards.

To deliver against this vision, we are looking for a collaborative leader with the spirit to make change happen and companion bold ideas that will continue to transform the experiences of our customers.

Role Purpose & Crucial Imperatives

The Vice President of Cloud Business Office (CBO) will work closely with the Director of the Cloud Business Office (CBO) and IT leadership to support the vision and strategy for governance across technologies, including Cloud, and contribute to senior governance forums, including the Group Cloud Governance Committee (GCGC).

The CBO VP will act as a key contributor within the cross-functional governing body that aligns the company's business strategy with its cloud adoption, supporting cloud governance, financial management (FinOps), risk management, and workforce enablement initiatives.

You will support several core pillars across the Cloud Business Office to ensure effective cloud transformation:

* **Strategic Alignment:**
  Supporting cloud initiatives that align with the broader goals of the organization, contributing to the Cloud Strategy.
* **Governance and Compliance:**
  Implementing guardrails, security policies, and frameworks to monitor risk and meet regulatory requirements.
* **Architecture and Enablement:**
  Supporting cloud architecture standards, contributing to workforce upskilling, and assisting engineering teams with best practices.
* **Workforce Enablement:**
  Identifying skills gaps, partnering with HR to support training initiatives, and fostering a "cloud-first" culture.
* **Financial Management (FinOps):**
  Supporting the oversight of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), assisting with budget forecasting, tracking billing, and identifying cloud spend optimization opportunities.

Responsibilities

As part of the CBO, you will have the following key responsibilities in order to fulfil the role purpose above:

* **Strategic Oversight:**
  Contribute to the organization's overarching multi-cloud strategy while managing interdependencies across the business.
* **Budget & Forecasting:**
  Work with Finance to establish cost-awareness regimes and build executive dashboards for cloud spend and ROI.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Work with cross-function and global teams, security/risk teams, and technical delivery teams to resolve blockers.
* **Change Management:**
  Contribute to the cultural transition to cloud, ensuring staff are reskilled and organizational KPIs are tracked
* **Manage Risks:**
  Maintain awareness of architecture risks and operational risks. Minimize the likelihood of these occurring through identification, assessment, mitigation and controls, loss identification and reporting in accordance with Nomura’s risk management policy.

In addition, you will also need to:

· Contribute to an agile technology architecture vision and strategy to enable CTO governance for new Cloud technologies. Share best practice within the Group Chief Architect community.

· Support a CTO Design Authority that brings together senior leaders to make strategic decision, taking care to socialise non-functional designs and choices to the relevant Group governance group.

· Align CTO with the Group Architecture principles and standards. Be an active member of the Architect community to help evolve Architecture best practice and embed these across the Technology landscape.

· Contribute to the development and implementation of CTO architecture strategy and standards, within the construct of the Group Architecture framework.

· Contribute to the development of platform and solution architectures and designs through governance ensuring that the target for architecture is implemented consistently across the CTO function and drive the realisation of strategy. Manage trade-offs and balances functional, service quality and cost efficiency requirements as well as adherence to appropriate standards.

· Consult on new best practices, processes, operating model, techniques, products, services, technologies and standards where needed against identified use cases, via the appropriate governance bodies.

· Stay abreast of technology trends and advise CTO business/CIO/Chief Architects and the Business about potential benefits/impacts.

Our ideal candidate will be a proficient cloud architecture leader that can demonstrate transformative influence, business value and real measurable impact at a business and technology level. They should bring passion, imagination, a partnership approach and demonstrable experience for initiating and seeing through disruptive change, collaborating with agile development teams, and helping establish a strong DevOps culture.

**Essential Qualifications & Skills:**

· Strong experience of manging complex technology governance.

· Experience of Public Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Server Virtualisation (VMware), Networking (TCPIP), Storage (NAS, SAN), Containers, Databases, Middleware and Data Centres.

· Experience of Public Cloud and Private Cloud financial management practices.

· Experience in digital and broader architectural transformation, including AI transformation, applying solutions from experience in decomposing monolithic solutions and methods to manage technical legacy.

· Understanding of and practical experience working with DevOps toolsets and frameworks.

**More extensive technical knowledge and experience sought:**

· Experience of enterprise level software for scale delivery working in digital domains where multi deployments of security and processes are key factors.

· Specialist cloud-based technology at scale and cloud solutions which include AWS as well as on-prem cloud and up to date on cloud development trends.

We prohibit discrimination in the workplace whether on grounds of gender, marital or domestic partnership status, pregnancy, carer’s responsibilities, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, race, color, national or ethnic origins, religious belief, disability or age.*

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview**
The Global Information Security (GIS) is responsible for protecting Bank information systems, confidential and proprietary data, and customer information. The team develops the Bank’s Information Security strategy and policy, manages the Information Security program, and identifies and addresses vulnerabilities, Develops, deploys and manages a risk-based controls portfolio, Manages and operates global security operations center that monitor, detects and responds to cybersecurity incidents.
  
  
GIS Identity & Access management (IAM) Access Control Team goal is to ensure that the control processes and effectiveness are within the identified risk tolerance. Manage the performance and effectiveness of the working control through the establishment of metrics with thresholds. Validate the reasonability of Laws, Rules and Regulations mapping alignment to the controls, as aligned by the GIS Policy team.
  
  
**Job Description**
In support of the Cloud Security program and the delivery of an operational framework, the role requires hands-on knowledge and experience with the policies, tools, configurations, and rules needed to deploy solutions that manage the security of cloud platforms and reduce risk to bank workloads in the cloud.
  
  
The role supports the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for IAM controls in cloud environments and help drive implementation of the designed control environment. This includes developing cloud IAM requirements based on threat models, laws, rules, and regulations, driving related updates to Policy, Standards, and Baselines, and assessing operational readiness of process and technical capabilities to implement the required controls.
  
  
The successful analyst is result-oriented and business-focused, and succeeds at interfacing across multiple organizational units at various levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Ensure IAM technology and controls for cloud are implemented, monitored, and adhered to established IAM standards.
* Achieve intended cloud IAM outcomes through the development and enhancement of applicable standards, processes, data elements, oversight, and governance for the bank’s cloud infrastructure, systems, and applications.
* Develop cloud IAM requirements based on threat models, laws, rules, and regulations, and drive related updates to Policy, Standards, and Baselines.
* Assess operational readiness of process and technical capabilities to implement required controls; determine whether existing or proposed controls satisfy policy, regulatory, and control requirements.
* Appropriately assess risk when business and technology decisions are made, demonstrating a risk management mindset to safeguard the bank’s reputation, clients, and assets by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations and adhering to Policy and Standards.
* Apply industry IAM best practices, templates, and documentation, while proposing improvements based on practical knowledge.
* Influence technology and platform owners to build and implement necessary IAM controls into cloud environments to create a smooth and effective cloud IAM adoption experience.
* Engage with Product Managers and Senior Architects to understand the strategic technology roadmap and the resulting need for modernized security principles.
* Consult with the business to identify gaps and governance issues, leveraging domain expertise to find effective solutions.
* Provide IAM subject matter expertise within the business and technical domain to support scope and requirement decisions.
* Perform impact analysis of modifications or enhancements, working closely with development teams to refine requirements into implementable specifications.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations through comprehensive UAT/QA testing of functionality and quality, and confirm the delivery timeline and adoption plan are fit for purpose.
* Create required documentation, playbooks, job aides, workflows, and training material as part of deployment and adoption activities.
* Support the design and update of new and existing controls, including the streamlining and automation of reporting.
* Develop and maintain documentation that accurately describes the current cloud IAM control environment for review by oversight organizations (Audit, Compliance, Operational Risk, Regulators).

**Requirements**

* Education

BE/BTECH/MCA/MSC (IT) equivalent (Any Technical Degree)
  
  

* Certifications If Any

NA
  
  

* Experience Range

8+ years of technology/information security experience
  
  
**Foundational Skills**

* 8+ years of experience in cyber security or a technology-related field.
* Deep, applied knowledge of the IAM domain (business and technical) and of cloud IAM threat models and related security controls.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud IAM technology and related business processes.
* Experience evaluating threats and risks posed by new cloud technologies and deployment models, and determining best-fit mitigations for advanced cyber threats (attack tactics, techniques, and procedures).
* Ability to understand the intent of policy, regulations, and control requirements and determine whether existing or proposed operational controls satisfy them.
* Familiarity with common information security and data protection frameworks and standards (e.g., CIS, NIST, MITRE, ITIL, COBIT, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS, ISO 27001).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail; able to communicate with business leaders, users, and tech-savvy stakeholders, and to tailor messages across audiences with varying technical understanding.
* Strong ability to interact, communicate, and influence vertically and laterally, and to collaborate and influence across peer groups and various levels of management.
* Excellent organizational skills; able to effectively prioritize multiple competing tasks in a dynamic environment.
* Experience participating in large or complex projects; strong project management skills.
* Proactive self-starter able to drive direction and work independently on initiatives with minimal oversight.
* Ability to coordinate and facilitate delivery routines (kick-offs, status reviews, stakeholder meetings, change controls, tollgates).
* Ability to create management-level reporting using aggregated data.
* Experience working in Agile methodology with a deep understanding of all phases of the SDLC.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conceptual-thinking skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, SharePoint), with the ability to analyze data, distill key data points, and present information effectively.
* A broad knowledge of information security principles and security capabilities

**Desired Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Azure Security Center, AWS Security Hub, or Google Cloud Security.
* Detailed, bank-specific knowledge across Identity & Access Management, application security, risk assessments, cloud technologies, and GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) with emphasis on security processes and controls.
* Familiarity with financial industry laws, rules, regulations, and guidance documents.
* Experience within, or interacting with examiners and partners across, control oversight organizations such as Audit, Compliance, Operational Risk, Regulators, and independent assessment organizations.
* Experience implementing information security strategy, including compliance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to work with both technical and non-technical business owners.
* Highly organized, motivated self-starter who excels at adapting to changing business needs, anticipating problems, and executing solutions while balancing multiple competing priorities.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

Amazon is looking for a Solutions Architect Manager to lead a team of solutions architects who design and deliver scalable, reliable systems that directly impact how our customers experience our products and services. In this role, you will define the strategic direction for your team, partner with cross-functional stakeholders, and drive architectural decisions that balance performance, cost, security, and operational excellence. You will navigate ambiguity, set clear goals, and establish the metrics that measure success — all while developing the next generation of technical talent on your team.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Define and communicate team vision, goals, and long-term strategy by working backwards from customer problems, partnering with stakeholders across engineering, product, and business teams to align on priorities and architectural direction.
* Lead architectural reviews and drive system design decisions, evaluating tradeoffs across reliability, security, performance, and cost while ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable over time.
* Build, grow, and manage an inclusive team of solutions architects, providing coaching, career development, and actionable feedback that empowers each team member to deliver results and advance their professional growth.
* Establish workflows, service level agreements, and audit mechanisms that ensure operational excellence, data-driven decision-making, and measurable quality across your team's deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes and reduce complexity, leveraging generative artificial intelligence tools and reusable patterns to improve team productivity and accelerate solution delivery.

A day in the life
  
  
You might start your morning reviewing an architecture proposal from a team member, asking targeted questions that sharpen the design before a stakeholder review. After a quick sync with partner engineering teams to align on integration timelines, you shift into a one-on-one with a direct report to discuss their development goals and an upcoming stretch project. Later, you prepare a narrative for leadership that outlines your team's progress against quarterly objectives and flags emerging risks. Throughout, you balance hands-on technical guidance with the strategic thinking needed to keep your team moving in the right direction.

We value collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to operational rigor. You will influence security, network, and operations decisions at executive and C\-levels (CISO, CTO, SVP and above) and translate security architecture into measurable outcomes — risk reduction, faster mean\-time\-to\-detect/respond, lower threat dwell\-time, stronger compliance posture, and analyst productivity — so customers can see the business value, not just the technology. You will architect zero trust transformations and security\-by\-design controls (segmentation, secure connectivity, policy\-based isolation) that embed protection into routing, transport, data center, edge, and peering layers, then develop the observability framework and high\-fidelity detections that power an agentic, AI\-driven SOC. You will uncover new and expansion security opportunities, lead CX security RFI/RFP responses, and scope and price cross\-architecture proposals so they can be cleanly delivered by CX's technical delivery teams — staying lightly engaged post\-sale to ensure realization and bring together reference wins. Success looks like a growing, balanced CX Security business across APJ SP, with customers advancing along zero trust, security\-by\-design, and SOC\-modernization journeys that Cisco helped them design and deliver.
   

  

**Security \& Service Provider Technical Domains**
 You Are Expected To Bring Architect\-level Expertise Across At Least Two Domains — Networking And Security Architecture — With Cross\-domain Fluency Over The Following
   

  

* Zero Trust Architecture — zero trust design principles, identity and access, least\-privilege/segmented access, and assume\-breach patterns at SP scale.
* Security\-by\-Design \& Infrastructure Controls — segmentation/micro\-segmentation, secure connectivity, DDoS protection, secure firewalling, and SP edge/peering security embedded in the fabric.
* Networking Foundation — SP routing, transport, data center, and edge architectures as the substrate into which security is infused.
* Observability \& Telemetry Engineering — data collection, parsing, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, and federated search across distributed, multi\-cloud data estates.
* Modern SOC \& Agentic Operations — high\-fidelity, actionable detection use cases, agentic investigation and response, advanced analytics, and SOC modernization.
* AI\-Driven Security — embedding AI and agentic capabilities across the security lifecycle to accelerate detection, investigation, and response.


**APJ Regional Context**
 This role drives and grows the CX Security business across the APJ Service Provider vertical — operating across Japan, Australia/New Zealand, ASEAN (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Vietnam), and India — markets with varying security maturity and regulatory environments. You will account for the global nature of strategic SP customers while navigating multi\-country deployments, data sovereignty, in\-country data residency, and security/privacy compliance requirements specific to APJ, and partner with the regional SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to orchestrate large\-scale transformations. Preferred hiring locations: Indonesia, Malaysia, India.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree \+ 12 years of related experience, OR Master's degree \+ 8 years, OR PhD \+ 5 years, OR equivalent relevant work experience.
* Deep networking expertise with demonstrated ability to apply zero trust security design principles (verify explicitly, least\-privilege access, assume breach) to transform customer security architectures at Service Provider scale.
* Shown mastery of security\-by\-design (network segmentation/micro\-segmentation and infrastructure controls) AND the design of observability frameworks and a modern SOC for detection and response (data collection, ingestion, normalization, enrichment, federated search, and high\-fidelity detection use cases).
* Practical AI fluency for security: demonstrated experience designing AI\-driven detection, investigation, and response and building high\-fidelity, agentic/automation\-led SOC workflows.
* Deep technical pre\-sales experience AND professional services/delivery experience, holding required certifications: CCNP Service Provider (or CCNP Enterprise/equivalent) AND CCNP Security (or equivalent) AND CISSP (or equivalent senior security architecture certification).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Expert\-level certifications such as CCIE Service Provider, CCIE Enterprise, or CCIE Security; and/or security architecture frameworks such as SABSA or TOGAF.
* Zero trust / SOC and security\-analytics certifications (e.g., Splunk certifications, SANS/GIAC such as GCIH/GCDA), AI\-security credentials, and/or cloud\-security specializations (AWS / Azure / GCP).
* Strong, fluent English (written and spoken) with the executive presence to influence at CISO/CTO/SVP\-and\-above level across diverse APJ markets.
* Recognized strategic influencer, comfortable shaping customer security vision and representing Cisco in industry forums and strategic alliances.
* Skilled at orchestrating the SI and channel\-partner ecosystem to deliver large\-scale, multi\-country Service Provider security transformations.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 Forward\-deployed engineers at Stackbinary take a client problem from scoping to a running system, usually in about two weeks, and then move to the next one. You decide the architecture, build across the stack with AI tools, deploy, and stand behind the result in the client demo. Stacks change from project to project; the fundamentals do not. This is on site five days a week in Kandivali East, Mumbai. Everyone starts with a one\-month paid trial at Rs 25,000\. Engineers who clear it move to a base of Rs 35,000 a month plus variable pay tied to the projects they deliver. Engineers on this plan have earned between Rs 35,000 and Rs 70,000 a month.

 Hand a system over in a state another engineer can maintain

title: Technology Lead
description:
**Job Description**
 We are looking for a dynamic and technically versatile Technology Lead to spearhead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise\-grade software solutions. The successful candidate will bring deep proficiency in both Python (Django) and Java (Spring Boot), paired with hands\-on AWS cloud experience and a proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow high\- performing engineering teams. As a Tech Lead, you will sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and people leadership. You will own the technical direction of one or more squads, drive architectural decisions, ensure code quality, and act as the primary liaison between engineering and product/business stakeholders. You are expected to lead by example, writing production\-quality code while enabling those around you to do the same. The candidate will have responsibilities across the following functions: Technical Leadership and Architecture: \- Own the end\-to\-end technical vision for assigned products or streams, driving design decisions from ideation through production. \- Conduct architecture reviews and guide system design, API contracts, data modelling, and service boundaries. \- Champion engineering best practices: clean code, SOLID principles, design patterns, comprehensive test coverage, and documentation. \- Evaluate and introduce new technologies, frameworks, and tooling where they improve delivery speed, reliability, or maintainability. \- Lead technical threat\-modelling sessions and ensure non\-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security) are embedded in every design. Python / Django Development: \- Lead the development of back\-end services, REST/GraphQL APIs, and data\-processing pipelines using Python and Django. \- Establish coding standards, review PRs, and maintain a high bar for Python code quality across the team. \- Guide the team on Django ORM optimisation, DRF serialiser design, Celery task management, and secure session/auth patterns. \- Oversee database migration strategies and ensure zero\-downtime deployment of schema changes. Java / Spring Boot Development: \- Architect and develop microservices and enterprise integrations using Java and Spring Boot. \- Apply Spring ecosystem best practices: dependency injection, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Spring Cloud, and Actuator for observability. \- Drive inter\-service communication design (REST, gRPC, messaging via Kafka or RabbitMQ) and define service\-level contracts. \- Guide team members on Java concurrency, JVM tuning, and performance profiling. AWS Cloud and Infrastructure: \- Define and oversee the cloud infrastructure strategy for team workloads on AWS. \- Govern CI/CD pipelines, IaC (CloudFormation/Terraform), and deployment automation across environments. \- Ensure secure, cost\-optimised, and resilient architectures leveraging appropriate AWS managed services. \- Act as the primary escalation point for production incidents, leading root\-cause analysis and post\-mortems. Team and Project Management: \- Manage day\-to\-day delivery of sprint commitments, maintaining velocity and proactively surfacing risks. \- Facilitate Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and continuously improve team processes. \- Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers through structured 1\-on\-1s, code reviews, and pairing sessions. \- Collaborate with Product Managers, UX, QA, and DevOps to define roadmaps, estimate effort, and prioritise work. Requirements: \- Overall Experience: Minimum 8 years. \- At least 8 years of progressive, commercial software engineering experience, with a clear trajectory from individual contributor toward technical leadership. \- Demonstrable history of owning and delivering complex, multi\-tier applications in production environments with high availability and reliability requirements. \- Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, including active participation in or facilitation of ceremonies. \- Track record of effective cross\-functional collaboration across product, QA, design, and infrastructure teams. \- Python and Django: minimum 5 years. \- Candidates must demonstrate at least 5 years of production development using Python and Django: Python 3 x proficiency: async/await, type annotations, decorators, generators, context managers, and idiomatic Pythonic patterns. \- Deep familiarity with the Django framework core: ORM complex querysets, annotations, window functions, prefetch\_related / select\_related, and bulk operations. \- Middleware, signals, custom management commands, and the admin interface for internal tooling. \- Authentication and authorisation patterns including Django's built\-in auth, JWT, OAuth2 and session security hardening. \- Extensive experience with Django REST Framework (DRF): serialisers (ModelSerializer, nested writable), viewsets, routers, permissions, throttling, and API versioning. \- Asynchronous task processing with Celery \+ Redis or RabbitMQ: task routing, retry strategies, beat schedules, and monitoring with Flower. \- Testing excellence: pytest, Django TestCase, factory\_boy, pytest\-django, coverage reporting, and integration/E2E test strategies. \- Database expertise: PostgreSQL schema design, query optimisation (EXPLAIN ANALYZE), Django migrations at scale, and connection pooling (pgBouncer). \- Caching strategies with Redis or Memcached: cache invalidation patterns, cache\- aside, write\-through in a Django context. \- Django security best practices: CSRF, XSS, SQL injection prevention, secure cookie configuration, and rate limiting. Java and Spring Boot (minimum 5 years: \- Candidates must demonstrate at least 5 years of production development using Java and Spring Boot. \- Strong Java fundamentals: Java 11\+ features (records, sealed classes, var), generics, streams/lambdas, concurrency utilities, and JVM internals (GC tuning, heap sizing). Spring Boot expertise: \- Spring MVC / WebFlux for reactive and imperative REST APIs. \- Spring Security OAuth2 resource servers, JWT validation, method\-level security, and CORS configuration. \- Spring Data JPA / Hibernate entity mapping, lazy loading strategies, query optimisation, and transaction management. \- Spring Cloud Config Server, Service Discovery (Eureka), API Gateway, Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j). \- Spring Actuator, Micrometre, and integration with observability platforms. \- Microservices architecture: domain\-driven design, bounded contexts, synchronous (REST/gRPC) and asynchronous (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS) communication patterns. \- Containerisation of Java services: multi\-stage Docker builds, JVM options for containers, and deployment on ECS or EKS. \- Testing: JUnit 5 Mockito, Spring Boot Test, Testcontainers, WireMock, and contract testing with Spring Cloud Contract or Pact. \- Build tooling: Maven or Gradle, dependency management, BOM usage, and multi\- module project structures. AWS Cloud (minimum 2 years: \- Candidates must demonstrate at least 2 years of practical experience on AWS: Compute: EC2 (auto\-scaling, launch templates), ECS (Fargate/EC2\), EKS, and Lambda for event\-driven workloads. \- Networking: VPC design (subnets, NACLs, security groups), ALB/NLB, API Gateway, CloudFront, Route 53 and VPC Endpoints / PrivateLink. \- Storage and Data: S3 (lifecycle, versioning, signed URLs, event notifications), RDS/Aurora (PostgreSQL/MySQL), DynamoDB, ElastiCache, and SQS/SNS. \- Security and Identity: IAM roles, permission boundaries, and least\-privilege policies; AWS. \- Secrets Manager; KMS for key management; AWS WAF. \- Observability: CloudWatch Logs, Metrics, Alarms, Dashboards; AWS X\-Ray for distributed tracing. Team and Project Management Minimum 2 Years: \- Candidates must demonstrate at least 2 years in a team\-lead, engineering\-lead, or project\-lead capacity: \- Experience managing a team of engineers, including workload distribution, performance feedback, and career development conversations. \- Delivery ownership: tracking sprint goals, managing scope changes, identifying blockers early, and communicating status to stakeholders. \- Agile/Scrum facilitation: sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and velocity tracking. \- Stakeholder management: translating technical constraints and trade\-offs into language accessible to non\-technical business stakeholders. \- Risk and dependency management: identifying technical debt, managing cross\-team dependencies, and driving mitigations before they impact delivery. \- Onboarding and knowledge transfer: creating structured onboarding plans for new joiners and building team documentation culture. Preferred Qualifications: \- Exposure to LLM/Generative AI integrations: AWS Bedrock, LangChain, RAG pipelines, or vector databases. \- Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, Grafana/Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry. \- Knowledge of API security standards: OAuth 2\.0 OpenID Connect, mTLS. \- Prior experience in a regulated industry (banking, insurance, healthcare) with knowledge of compliance frameworks (PCI\-DSS, ISO 27001 SOC 2\). Technical Skills Summary: Languages and Frameworks: \- Primary: Python 3 x (Django, DRF, Celery), Java 11\+ (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security, Spring Data JPA). \- Supporting: SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL), Bash scripting; JavaScript familiarity is a plus. \- Databases and Caching Relational: PostgreSQL (primary), MySQL/MariaDB/Oracle. AWS Services: \- Compute and Containers: EC2 ECS (Fargate), EKS, Lambda, Auto Scaling Groups. \- Networking: VPC, ALB/NLB, API Gateway, CloudFront, Route 53 PrivateLink. \- Storage and Messaging: S3 RDS/Aurora, ElastiCache, SQS, SNS, MSK. \- Security: IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, WAF, Shield, AWS Config, Security Hub. \- DevOps: CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, ECR, CloudWatch, X\-Ray. DevOps and Engineering Practices: \- Containerisation: Docker (multi\-stage builds), Kubernetes basics. \- IaC: CloudFormation, Terraform. \- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline. \- Version Control: Git, GitFlow or trunk\-based development. \- Code Quality: SonarQube, pre\-commit hooks, linting (pylint, flake8 Checkstyle). Leadership and Behavioural Competencies: Engineering Leadership: \- Ability to set a clear technical vision and rally a team around it without imposing unnecessary top\-down constraints. \- Comfortable making and defending architectural trade\-off decisions under uncertainty and time pressure. \- Strong instinct for identifying tech debt, prioritising its resolution, and communicating its business impact. People Development: \- Proven track record of growing junior and mid\-level engineers through mentoring, structured feedback, and stretch assignments. \- Ability to identify individual strengths and align them to team needs and career goals. \- Creates a psychologically safe environment where team members raise concerns and experiment without fear of blame. Communication and Stakeholder Management: \- Excellent written and verbal communication to present a system design to engineers and summarise the same decision for a CTO or business sponsor. \- Skilled in facilitating workshops, design reviews, and technical interviews. \- Proactively shares knowledge, writes clear documentation, and encourages team\-wide transparency. Delivery and Problem Solving: \- Strong delivery mindset: comfortable balancing engineering quality with pragmatic trade\- offs to meet business timelines. \- Data\-driven approach to performance issues, capacity planning, and technology choices. \- Calm under pressure, leads incident response effectively, and instils a blameless post\- mortem culture. **About You:**
 We are seeking to onboard candidates with a track record of leading complex delivery, demonstrating technical depth and pragmatic leadership. You’re hands‑on when it matters, coach others effectively, and make clear design trade‑offs that improve customer and business outcomes. You communicate crisply, collaborate across functions, and keep teams focused on the few things that move the needle.

* Highly adaptable and comfortable working in ambiguous, problem\-solving environments.
* Strong evidence of teamwork and successful cross\-functional delivery; including particularly with customers, Product, Marketing, and Sales.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and collaboration skills.


 Behaviours that we look for
   

  

* Rigorous problem\-solving and systems thinking. Breaks down complex problems, evaluates multiple approaches, and designs scalable, maintainable architectures.

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

 We’re looking for Senior with expertise in SAP CPI Implementation to join the EYD GDS Integration practice. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Must be able to work on custom integration as well as standard integration packages

* Should have worked on Java and Groovy scripting
* Must be aware of SAP CPI support activities
* Must be able to perform root cause analysis of any re\-occurring or critical issues and proposing solutions for them
* Performs Unit, System and Integration testing at the various phases of the project lifecycle and document the results of the testing process


**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Experience to build Integration Strategy for customers having on premise and cloud application systems (SuccessFactors, S4HANA, Ariba etc) with an expertise on data architecture, governance and pre\-packaged cloud integration.
* Exposure to various business scenarios (A2A and B2B) and experience in working on all major adapters like SFTP, SOAP, REST, IDOC, ODATA, JDBC, SuccessFactors etc.
* Clarity of security concepts \- SSL and PGP encryptions etc.
* Prefer to have experience in Groovy scripts.
* Responsibilities, Qualifications, Certifications


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* College degree in related technology field (Computer, Engineering, Science, etc.) or comparable job experiences
* Approximately 9\+ years of experience in a development role. Able to exhibit a progression of increasingly complex job responsibilities during the period
* SAP certification is a plus


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Should have understanding and experience of integration best practices
* Excellent business communication skills
* Excellent leadership skills


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Integration practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:**

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Sia is a next\-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity.
   

  





 With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.
   

  

  

  

 Our Mumbai office was launched in 2024, marking an exciting new chapter for us. We’re building the team with people who are eager to shape something from the ground up — combining the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a startup with the backing and reach of a global brand.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join Sia’s AI Factory (AIF), embedded directly within a client’s engineering, product, or service team. The FDE is a hybrid role that pairs hands\-on software engineering with client\-facing delivery, sitting close to the client to close platform gaps and ship production use cases in parallel, rather than working at arm’s length through a traditional delivery layer.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Work embedded full\-time within the client’s engineering, product, or service team, participating directly in their planning, standups, and delivery cadence.


* Close platform gaps in real time: build the missing components, connectors, or tooling the client’s platform doesn’t yet provide.


* Deliver production use cases in parallel with platform build\-out, balancing near\-term delivery pressure against longer\-term platform health.


* Integrate with the client’s approved tools, APIs, and governance frameworks (e.g. controlled AI gateways) rather than introducing external dependencies.


* Communicate technical trade\-offs and blockers directly to client stakeholders, translating between Sia’s team and the client’s engineering leadership.


* Collaborate within a cross\-functional pod (client engineers, platform engineers, Sia engineers) in an agile/SCRUM setup.


* Escalate platform or scope risks early. FDE roles sit at the point where client demand and platform maturity meet.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s/master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.


* Experience \& Technical Skills:


* Strong Python skills, with production engineering experience, not limited to prototyping.


* Comfortable operating embedded within a client or external stakeholder team, with less structure/definition than an internal team typically has.


* Ability to quickly understand an unfamiliar codebase or platform and contribute production\-quality code within it.


* Experience with agent orchestration, RAG/LLM\-based applications, and tool/API integration is a strong plus.


* SiaGPT or comparable GenAI platform experience is a strong plus.


* Comfort working within governed enterprise environments (approved libraries/APIs/services, controlled AI gateways).


* Good to have: Spark, Databricks, AWS.


* Good to have: prior experience in regulated or enterprise domains (e.g. financial services, healthcare, or public sector).


**Additional Information**

**What We Offer**



* Opportunity to lead cutting\-edge AI projects in a global consulting environment.
* Leadership development programs and training sessions at our global centers.
* A dynamic and collaborative team environment with diverse projects.



**Position based in Mumbai (onsite)**




 Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customer engineering teams to ship production\-grade Cursor workflows that measurably improve how they build software.
   

  

 You’ll figure out what’s actually slowing a team down, design a practical solution, and own it end\-to\-end, from first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post\-production support. This is not a demo role. You are responsible for systems that work in the real world. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, New Delhi and Mumbai.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead discovery with customer engineers to identify the real bottleneck and define clear success metrics
* Design and build Cursor\-powered workflows (e.g., large\-scale refactors, migrations, PR review loops, incident → fix pipelines, spec → implementation systems)
* Ship a fast first version in days, then harden it into something reliable over weeks with proper rollout plans, monitoring, and iteration based on real usage
* Own production quality: tracing, evals, metrics, debugging model behavior, latency/cost tradeoffs, and failure modes
* Work directly with Staff\+/Platform/Eng leaders — going deep in code while also communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and push improvements back into the core Cursor product


 You may be a fit if
   

  

* You thrive in ambiguity and can turn fuzzy problems into clear scopes and shipped systems
* You’ve built and owned AI\-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real\-world model failures
* You’re comfortable leading discovery conversations and being accountable for customer outcomes
* You build end\-to\-end \- if it needs frontend, backend, infra, or prompt iteration, you’ll own it
* You’ve handled production reliability before (metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response)
* You’re strong in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript and can ramp quickly on new stacks

* Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

title: SQL Server Expert (On-Premise & Azure)
description:
**Job Summary** 




**We are looking for a Senior Database Developer with deep hands\-on expertise in Microsoft SQL Server to design data models, build and optimise T\-SQL, and deliver database\-backed features for enterprise applications. The role is development\-first: you will own schema design, stored procedure and query development, performance tuning, and data integration work, and will partner with the DBA/infrastructure function on production operations rather than owning them.** 









  





***Data Modelling \& Schema Design***



* **Translate business and product requirements into logical and physical data models**
* **Design normalised transactional schemas and denormalised reporting structures, and know when to use which**
* **Define keys, constraints, relationships, and data types that keep data correct by design**
* **Define indexing and partitioning strategy for new and evolving tables**
* **Plan and version schema changes so they can ship without breaking live systems**



***T\-SQL Development***



* **Develop and maintain stored procedures, functions, views, and triggers**
* **Write set\-based T\-SQL for high\-volume transactional and batch workloads**
* **Implement error handling, transaction management, and concurrency control (isolation levels, locking behaviour)**
* **Build reconciliation, validation, and data\-quality routines**
* **Support reporting requirements through views, procedures, and reporting datasets**



***Performance Engineering***



* **Analyse and tune slow queries using actual execution plans**
* **Apply indexing, query rewriting, and statistics management to remove bottlenecks**
* **Diagnose blocking, deadlocks, tempdb pressure, and parameter sniffing issues**
* **Design for scale — batching, partition elimination, and archival strategies as data volumes grow**
* **Establish performance baselines and prevent regressions before release**



***Data Integration \& Migration***



* **Build and maintain ETL/data movement using SSIS and/or Azure Data Factory**
* **Develop scripts for data migration, transformation, and validation**
* **Support movement of databases and workloads between on\-premise SQL Server and Azure SQL**



***Azure SQL (Working Level)***



* **Develop against Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance**
* **Understand feature and compatibility differences from on\-premise SQL Server**
* **Use Query Performance Insight and Azure Monitor to investigate query performance**
* **Write code that is cost\-aware in a consumption\-based environment**



***Engineering Practice \& Collaboration***



* **Work with product and application development teams through design, build, and release**
* **Manage database code in source control and deploy through CI/CD pipelines**
* **Define and enforce database coding standards; review peers' SQL**
* **Write and maintain documentation for data models and key procedures**



***Production Support (Supporting Role)***



* **Troubleshoot production data and performance issues, with root cause analysis and permanent fixes**
* **Work alongside the DBA/infrastructure team on backups, recovery, security, and HA/DR — familiarity expected, ownership not required**



**Required Skills** 




***Must Have***



* **Microsoft SQL Server (2016/2019/2022\) and advanced T\-SQL**
* **Stored procedures, functions, views, triggers, CTEs, window functions, dynamic SQL**
* **Query optimisation, execution plan analysis, indexing and partitioning**
* **Relational data modelling and normalisation; schema design from requirements**
* **Transaction handling, isolation levels, and concurrency troubleshooting**
* **Hands\-on development experience against Azure SQL Database or Managed Instance**
* **Source control for database code (Git/TFS/Azure DevOps)**



***Good to Have***



* **SSIS or Azure Data Factory**
* **Data warehousing and dimensional modelling**
* **CI/CD for database deployments (DACPAC, Flyway, Liquibase, or similar)**
* **Python or PowerShell scripting**
* **Power BI or SSRS**
* **Awareness of backup/recovery and Always On concepts**
* **Exposure to .NET application development**
* **NoSQL exposure**



**Qualification \& Details** 



* **Bachelor's/Master's in Computer Science, IT, or related field**
* **Experience: 4–7 years, predominantly in SQL Server development**
* **Employment Type: Full\-Time \| Work Mode: WFO \| Location: Mumbai**
* **Notice Period: Immediate to 30 days preferred**
